stories.title: St. Louis police fatally shoot man after alleged carjacking attempt in Dutchtown
stories.summary: Police said a 42-year-old man pointed a BB pistol at a driver and refused repeated orders to drop it. The driver escaped unharmed.

stories.title: Missing 8-year-old dies after being found in St. Francois County lake
stories.summary: A community member found the child on Sunday in Lac Carmel in St. Francois County. Rescuers performed CPR, and medics pronounced the child dead at 4:37 p.m.

stories.title: Andy Richter shares behind-the-scenes stories from 'Elf' during St. Louis visit
stories.summary: The comedian and actor's new book, "Elf Unwrapped: Behind the Scenes of a Christmas Classic," reveals how the beloved holiday movie almost wasn't made.

stories.title: Pedestrian fatally struck on Highway A in Festus
stories.summary: Troopers said the man was walking in the roadway at about 11 p.m. Friday when an SUV fatally struck him.

stories.title: Flight cancellations, delays continue at St. Louis airport day after nationwide ground stop
stories.summary: Lingering cancellations and delays from Friday's ground stop have left some passengers in limbo Saturday at Lambert Airport.

stories.title: Missing 14-year-old boy found safe
stories.summary: St. Louis County police said the missing teenager was found safe Saturday.

stories.title: Grassroots Hope: How a 9-year-old and a local couple are bringing warmth to St. Louis
stories.summary: From a little girl's clothing drive to a couple's 10,000 coat donation, two grassroots initiatives are bringing warmth and healing to tornado-scarred STL.

stories.title: FAA lifts ground stop after flights halted at Lambert, airports nationwide due to 'extraordinary circumstances'
stories.summary: Flights were halted at airports across the United States due to unspecified "extraordinary circumstances," the FAA said.

stories.title: St. Louis opens emergency shelters early for the season as temperatures drop below freezing
stories.summary: City leaders activated Code Blue before Dec. 1, opening 500 total beds through Sunday as shelters brace for high winter demand.

stories.title: LIVE: FAA grounds flights in St. Louis' Lambert Airport, airports nationwide
stories.summary: Here's the latest on the FAA's nationwide ground stop.

stories.title: Tensions flare at St. Louis City Hall as advocates and aldermen demand answers on jail deaths
stories.summary: Demonstrators hung banners inside the rotunda as city officials face tough questioning over medical neglect and 22 in-custody fatalities since 2020.

stories.title: St. Louis fire chief urges heating safety as temperatures drop
stories.summary: St. Louis Fire Chief Dennis Jenkerson urges residents to check smoke and carbon monoxide detectors and use space heaters safely as temperatures drop this weekend.
